{{Coins|1,300}}, {{Exp|260}} & {{TimeScaleTicket|2}} ([[Healthy Enemies]]) }} ==Description== '''Challenge Trials''' is a difficult mode that can only be played through [[Matchmaking]]. It has a requirement of {{Level|40}}. The main gimmick of the mode is that every three hours, a different trial starts, which has a new modifier, map, and rewards. Upon successful triumph of this mode, the modifier that was active on that mode would be given to players to use on any match if this was their first time completing the trial for that modifier. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. The health of enemies in this mode scales with the player count, starting at two players. The increase is 10% in duo, 25% in trio and 40% in quad. It is applied after attributes, like Bloated, meaning they can affect the health of an enemy. The increase is not always the stated amount. [[Consumables]] and [[Time Scale]] are both disabled on this mode regardless of the current modifier. However, [[Skills]] are enabled across all modifiers on this mode. ==Trials== '''Challenge Trials''' have a unique mechanic of having a specific modifier be applied every three hours to it, which on top of what is stated dictates other things like if [[Skills]] are enabled or what map it is on. The following trials are available in this order: *[[Speedy Enemies]], all enemies are [[Nimble]], map set to [[Wrecked Battlefield]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Glass]], base health is set to 1, map set to [[Stained Temple]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Quarantine]], increases placement footprint of towers by 10, map set to [[Dusty Bridges]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Fog]], tower range is reduced by 35%, map set to [[Winter Abyss]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Limitation Makes Creativity]], tower placement limits are decreased by 50%, map set to [[Coral Deep]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Flying Enemies]], all enemies become [[Flying]] after Wave 5, map set to [[Sacred Mountains]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Jailed Towers (Modifier)|Jailed Towers]], a tower type is jailed every wave after Wave 5, map set to [[Night Station]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Exploding Enemies]], enemies explode on death, map set to [[Wrecked Battlefield II]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Inflation]], all prices are increased by 50%, map set to [[Cyber City]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Committed]], towers cannot be sold, map set to [[Retro Zone]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Hidden Enemies]], all enemies become [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] after Wave 5, map set to [[Forgetten Docks]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Broke]], income is reduced by 50%, map set to [[Medieval Times]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *[[Healthy Enemies]], all enemies are [[Bloated]], map set to [[Four Seasons]] and [[Skills]] are enabled. *After this, the order is repeated starting from the first trial in this list. ==Rewards== Rewards are only given out on triumph, which means losing on any wave gives {{Exp|0}} and no rewards. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Between waves 1 to 30, the wave bonus is calculated as: :{{Money|300}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|100}})^1.03 Between waves 31 and 40, it is calculated as: :{{Money|300}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|100}})^1.07 Depending on player count, the wave bonus is reduced using multipliers. Previously, it incorrectly stated that it sets the placement limit to 20 while also removing individual tower placement limits. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **Wave skip now appears after one third of the wave has passed instead of after 20 seconds. ==Notes== {{ModeNavBox}}
